job_description:
AI Engineer (all levels)
UNITY AG · Berlin

Are you looking for a challenging role where you put modern AI technologies into practice and actively work on pioneering solutions? Do you want to be part of a strong team where you can develop professionally and technologically?

Join us in shaping innovative AI solutions and preparing our customers for the digital future.

This is what you can expect

• Design and develop innovative AI use cases: from the idea through the prototype to productive use at the customer’s site.
• Build modern agentic AI systems based on LLMs, multi-agent frameworks and tool integration (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI).
• Responsible for the full-stack development of AI applications, from backend logic and API design to intuitive frontend interfaces.
• Advise our clients’ specialist and IT departments on identifying and prioritizing AI potential and selecting suitable technologies.
• Actively participate with us in shaping internal knowledge building on AI development patterns and best practices.

This is what you bring with you

Extensive know-how in AI development and modern software architectures, which you have acquired through:
• Experience in the development of AI-based applications, especially with Large Language Models (LLMs), Prompt Engineering and Agentic Coding Patterns (e.g., ReAct, Tool Use, Chain-of-Thought).
• Senior Level: Several years of practical experience in the design and operation of productive AI systems, including RAG architectures, fine-tuning and evaluation of LLM pipelines.
• Solid full-stack competence: With backend (Python, Node.js, etc.) and frontend (React, Vue, etc.), you can independently build a complete AI application.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and the deployment of AI applications (containers, APIs, serverless).
• Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), vector databases (e.g. Elasticsearch, pgvector, etc.) or AI observability tools.
• Knowledge of MLOps and the structured operation of AI models in production environments.
• Important! Conciseness in communication and presentation in German (from C1) and English (from B2).
• Successfully completed studies in the field of (business) informatics, data science, AI or a comparable technical focus.

Also helpful for your success at UNITY: analytical problem-solving skills, a strong customer focus/service mentality, as well as a proactive approach, curiosity, and entrepreneurial spirit. An above-average desire for teamwork and cohesion.
